lines.zh: 我四条腿落地，重量都压得很实。
lines.en: Four legs land and all my weight settles.
I walk the edge of the wood.
The wind pushes the fur on me.
My tail flattens the grass.
Step by step, I go forward.

lines.zh: 我从花丛旁经过，没踩坏。
lines.en: I pass the flowers without crushing them.
My claws sink into the wet soil.
I stop and sniff first.
I go down along the hillside.
My walk is steady, like a habit.
I lower my head to watch my footing.
I head deeper into the wood.
I lie with my forelegs crossed.
There are grass seeds in my fur.
I breathe out, slow and steady.
Sunlight rests along my spine.
I'm listening to the wood's stir.

lines.zh: 我抬头听了听，又低回去。
lines.en: I lift my head to listen, then lower it.
My tail taps the ground softly.
My eyes are half lidded.
The heat in me slowly fades.
I've nothing to hurry for.

lines.zh: 我这只独狼，甲上全是咬痕。
lines.en: A lone wolf, my armor all bite marks.

lines.zh: 风把我的毛一层层推开。
lines.en: The wind parts my fur in layers.

lines.zh: 你踩的那朵花，我看见了。
lines.en: I saw the flower you stepped on.
There's still warmth on me.
I don't necessarily have to fight.
I saw you step back.

lines.zh: 我的爪子在地上抓了抓。
lines.en: My claws scrape the ground.
What brings you to this wood?
The heat on me is still rising.
Don't stand on my way out.
That one found my ribs.
I hunch to guard it.
My fur is all standing up.
Blood drips onto the grass.

lines.zh: 我把头甩了甩，血飞出去。
lines.en: I shake my head and blood flies.
Teeth clenched, I straighten.
The wound under my shoulder plate throbs.
Heat rises off me again.

lines.zh: 这股血腥味让我喉头发热。
lines.en: That smell of blood heats my throat.
That's not enough to fill me.

lines.zh: 这味道像林子里死掉的鹿。
lines.en: Smells like a dead deer in the wood.
Put it down and I'll keep off.
I've smelled this before.

lines.zh: 我把它拖到树后面去吃。
lines.en: I drag it behind a tree to eat.
I chew it bite by bite.
The heat in me rises again.
I leave the bone where it fell.
I wait for you to set the meat down.

lines.zh: 你撞到我，自己退了几步。
lines.en: You hit me and went back several steps.
All four claws are dug into the dirt.

lines.zh: 这一下我身上的毛都炸了。
lines.en: That made my fur bristle.
I turn my shoulder and let you pass.
Your foot is on my tail tip.
A sound comes from my throat.
Neither of us went down.
Your weight can't shift me.
I angle my body aside.
I wait for you to go first.
I'm the only one in this wood.
My heat has slowly banked down.
I remember someone beside me.
That's all in the past.
I rest my head on my forelegs.
Flowers are blooming beside me.
I don't tread on them.
The wind blows petals onto me.
I lie there until dark.
The wood is quiet at night.
I crack it open.
I chew twice and spit it out.
I spit it onto the ground.

lines.zh: 骨头在我爪下压得发响。
lines.en: The bone creaks under my paw.
It rolls around in my mouth.
I paw it aside.
I carried it back.
I sniff, then paw it away.
Something's moving at the treeline.
I work my way over there.
I've got it in my sights.
Heat is rising off me.
My claws can reach you now.
I inch my way toward it.
It doesn't have many ways out.
It swings around without warning.
It's running for the wood.
I follow with a checked stride.
It goes left; I cut ahead.
I hold my stride in check.
It's not slow.
I've sealed its way back.
It stops to pant.
The gap keeps closing.
The heat in me is strong now.

lines.zh: 我压着步子跟着，它往左我就抄到前面。
lines.en: I pace it; it goes left and I cut ahead.
I turn side-on in front of it.
My forepaw sweeps across.
That one knocked it down.

lines.zh: 我四条腿落地，重量实实地撞过去。
lines.en: Four legs land and my full weight slams forward.
It slams into a trunk.
It broke free in a surge.
I lunge a second time.
It's flat on the ground.
I step back and watch it.
Three blocks tall, and the claws retract.

lines.zh: 它不再动了，热气还在甲缝里。
lines.en: It stopped moving; heat lingers in my seams.
The first sight is a field of flowers.
All four legs are under me.
The heat in me ebbs away.
I shake myself once.
Seeds cling to my fur.
I look up; the trees are tall.
There's a faint sound far off.
I walk toward that sound.
I take my time.
I stop at the wood's edge.

lines.zh: 我从坡上滚下来，摔得很重。
lines.en: I tumble down the slope and land hard.
Water pours in and I fight it.

lines.zh: 一箭扎进我肩上的毛里。
lines.en: An arrow buries in my shoulder fur.

lines.zh: 我身体里的热被搅乱了。
lines.en: The heat in me has been stirred awry.
With no prey, my teeth have gone dull.

lines.zh: 雷打下来，我四条腿都僵了。
lines.en: Lightning strikes and all four legs lock.
The ground I stood on is gone.
